score_notes.christology: As children of God, we share in the abundant life that is ours through Jesus Christ, an inheritance that includes the gifts of the Spirit and the hope and the promise of a place in God’s kingdom.
score_notes.gender: We openly welcome persons of all sexual orientation, gender expression, socioeconomic status, family configuration, age, national origin, race, religious or non-religious background, and physical or mental condition.
score_notes.leadership: We proclaim God’s inclusive welcome to the Communion Table, and affirm that full and equal participation in the life and leadership of our church is open to all.
score_notes.mission: We seek to continue to learn and grow in our efforts to be a movement for wholeness in a fragmented world.
score_notes.cultural: As followers of Christ we understand our calling to “ do justice, love kindness and walk humbly with God ” (Micah 6:8).
score_notes.denominational: We are affiliated with the Christian Church (Disciples of Christ), a denomination of almost one million members, who profess faith in Jesus Christ and seek, in every aspect of life together to follow God in paths of love, justice, and service.
